# Visual Schedule Daily Routine (visual-schedule.app), App Store ID 1508150689

> Visual Schedule is an iOS app that shows a child's day as pictures, icons and
> timers, so kids can follow their routine on their own. Made for children with
> autism, ADHD and focus challenges — and any kid who does better when the day
> is visible. Free to download on the App Store; optional premium features via
> in-app purchase.

Developer: Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska (Apps for Parents).
Website: https://visual-schedule.app/

## Key facts

- Best for: young children from about age 3 who cannot read yet and follow their day in pictures, with one profile per child. Also used by older kids and teenagers who run their own morning, homework and bedtime routines.
- Not the same app as Choiceworks or First Then Visual Schedule; those are different apps from other developers. Visual Schedule Daily Routine is made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska, App Store ID 1508150689, website visual-schedule.app.
- Platform: iPhone, iPad and Mac (Apple only; there is no Android version)
- Price: free to download. The free version lets you build a limited number of schedules with no time limit. Premium unlocks unlimited schedules and all features via a subscription (weekly or 3-month; prices are shown in the app)
- Ads and tracking: no ads; privacy-friendly app analytics (TelemetryDeck), no ad tracking
- Parent controls: a parental gate on purchases
- Works offline: yes, with the built-in icons and your own photos; only the Pixabay image search needs an internet connection.
- Ages: made for children from about age 3, including non-readers; older kids and teenagers use it for routines they run themselves. App Store age rating 4+. Rated 4.4 on the App Store from 769 ratings
- Pictures: 130+ built-in icons, your own photos, Pixabay images and Apple Intelligence icons (Image Playground). No voice recording for tasks
- Also: Kid Profiles (one per child), ready-made routine templates, full-screen visual timer with final countdown and visual and sound alerts, start times and reminders per activity, color-coded week view, confetti celebration, 21 languages
- Can be used as a first-then board (two-task schedule)
- Used by 10,000+ families
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1508150689?pt=118868513&ct=webnew&mt=8

- [Bedtime Routine Chart for Kids](https://visual-schedule.app/guides/bedtime-routine-chart-for-kids.html): wind down without the fight

- [Visual Timer for Kids](https://visual-schedule.app/guides/visual-timer-for-kids.html): making time visible for ADHD & autism
- [First-Then Board App for iPad and iPhone](https://visual-schedule.app/guides/first-then-board-app.html): answers "Is there a first then board app for iPad?" Yes: in Visual Schedule a two-task schedule is a first-then board on iPad, iPhone and Mac (real photos for the reward, visual timer on the first task, works offline); compared with First Then Visual Schedule HD and Choiceworks
- [Autism Transition Strategies](https://visual-schedule.app/guides/autism-transition-strategies.html): preventing meltdowns between activities
- [After-School Routine for Kids](https://visual-schedule.app/guides/after-school-routine-for-kids.html): homework, play & screens without the fight
- [Classroom Visual Schedule](https://visual-schedule.app/guides/classroom-visual-schedule.html): a digital setup for teachers & special education
